evaluation: d cannot underflow: the descriptor is chosen because start <= o < end. d mod S and d / S are undefined for S = 0 (division, not overflow).
formula: d = o − start; stripe = d mod S; data_index = d / S
note: No overflow vector exists for the forward direction; the only hazard is S = 0, which earlier rules reject.
quotes: stripe      = d mod S                  (the stripe index varies fastest)
shadowed: Yes: S = 0 is rejected by the Section 9.2 rule 'S u32 ≠ 0' before the mapping runs, and the bootstrap's S >= 1 by Section 6.6. Outcome as case sidecar-s-zero.
target: the Recoverer's ordinal-to-stripe mapping (Section 3.3) after index acquisition (Section 13.3)
